opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to fund and connect a wallet to Binance Smart Chain and Remix, then send funds to a newly created contract and activate it. It presents that contract as automatically buying and selling on the user's behalf, with 90% allegedly transferred back to the wallet. Its stated mechanism is front-running retail investors for a bid-and-ask difference after gas fees, while repeated daily cycles with more capital are said to produce upwards of a thousand BNB per day. The supplied records do not verify the code, profitability, transactions, or claimed earnings. These instructions and return claims establish a purported automated trading opportunity requiring viewers to place funds into a deployed contract, while the unusually large earnings claim remains unverified.

citations.quote: if you just follow the description of the video as far as downloading MetaMask and also funding it Make sure that it's connected to the Binance Smart Chain
So we're just going to send some funds to that contract we just created
It will automatically sell within a minute and from there it will take 90% and automatically transit back to your wallet
The total profit of this front running transaction will be the difference between the bid and ask price (0.1 BNB) minus the higher gas fee, which is typically 0.03-0.05BNB.
you can run this cycle multiple times a day you can have upwards of a thousand BnB a day if you use a large amount than what I started with.
